channel.topic:
**Fomu** (FPGA Tomu): an open source Lattice iCE40UP5K FPGA board that fits inside a USB port, with enough logic for a RISC-V CPU and a USB softcore.

**Docs**
• [Fomu home page](https://tomu.im/fomu.html)
• [Fomu workshop](https://workshop.fomu.im/): from loading software to writing your own hardware
**Source**
• [fomu-hardware](https://github.com/im-tomu/fomu-hardware)
• [fomu-workshop](https://github.com/im-tomu/fomu-workshop)
• [fomu-toolchain](https://github.com/im-tomu/fomu-toolchain)
• [foboot](https://github.com/im-tomu/foboot): the bootloader
**Buy**
• [Crowd Supply](https://www.crowdsupply.com/sutajio-kosagi/fomu)

messages.content:
# Welcome to #🔌-fomu
This channel is for **Fomu**, the open source FPGA that fits inside a USB port. @Tim 'mithro' Ansell and @Xobs look after this channel.

**Start here**
- [Fomu home page](<https://tomu.im/fomu.html>)
- [Fomu workshop](<https://workshop.fomu.im/>): from loading software to writing your own hardware

**Source**
- [fomu-hardware](<https://github.com/im-tomu/fomu-hardware>)
- [fomu-workshop](<https://github.com/im-tomu/fomu-workshop>)
- [fomu-toolchain](<https://github.com/im-tomu/fomu-toolchain>)
- [foboot](<https://github.com/im-tomu/foboot>): the bootloader

**Buy**
- [Crowd Supply](<https://www.crowdsupply.com/sutajio-kosagi/fomu>)

Post your Fomu projects, questions and ideas here.
